'''Otol Nal''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who worked for the [[Yiyar clan]]'s [[Yiyar Salvage Corporation]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].
